title: Σοῦδα / Suda / «Суда» (Свида); unit: biographical entries on Greek poets (from Hesychius' Onomatologos)
author: Anonymous Byzantine compilers
size: 31,000+ entries (Adler, 5 vols). Unit estimate several hundred entries, 15–40k words.
edition: A. Adler, Lexicographi Graeci I (1928–38; Adler died 1966, so likely in copyright in RU/EU). Bernhardy 1834–53 (PD).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Суда): only 'более ста статей' rendered by Maxim the Greek (16th c.). No modern Russian translation found; only scattered excerpts.
en_evidence: Suda On Line: the last of 31,000+ entries was translated on 21 July 2014 (SOL history page; en.wikipedia).
other_translations: Latin 1581. No other complete modern translation found.
value: Main ancient source for the lives and work lists of Greek authors, much of it now lost. Indispensable to every Hellenist. A Russian version of the bio-bibliographical entries would serve all Russian classicists and students. RU-gap flagship.
ai_feasibility: high for prose biographies; medium where entries quote fragments. SOL is available for cross-checking, not as a base.
pilot_unit: Lives of the lyric, tragic and comic poets (about 150 entries; estimate 15k words).
